en-US.description: Tencent Meeting Rooms integrates with various hardware devices to provide a one-stop meeting experience with audio/video conferencing, wireless screen casting, and collaborative whiteboards.
en-US.longDescription: Tencent Meeting Rooms is a software system built specifically for meeting rooms that provides an integrated meeting experience with audio/video conferencing, wireless screen casting and interactive whiteboards, publishes audio/video authentication standards, and selects branded hardware consoles to provide a modern meeting room solution for enterprises together.
en-US.name: TencentMeetingRooms

zh-CN.description: 腾讯会议 Rooms 与多种硬件设备集成，提供音视频会议、无线投屏、协作白板的一站式会议体验。
zh-CN.longDescription: 腾讯会议 Rooms 是专为会议室打造的软件系统，提供音视频会议、无线投屏、触屏式白板的集成会议体验，开放音视频认证标准，臻选品牌硬件终端，共同为企业提供现代化的会议室解决方案。
zh-CN.name: 腾讯会议Rooms
zh-CN.publisher: 腾讯科技(深圳)有限公司
